title: Project idea: a booking system
why_it_matters: It combines SQL, auth and UI, which is exactly what teams build.
explanation: Build a small booking app: services, available time slots, and user bookings. The interesting bit is preventing double bookings with a database constraint. Add auth with Supabase and row-level security so users only see their bookings.
try_it: Sketch the tables you'd need: users, services, slots, bookings.
